contract.declared_domain: ASCII Datamesh error fragment; assignment separator len 1..16 and value is nonempty and terminates at the product delimiter set, or an ed_live_ token
contract.guarantee: recognized credential assignments and ed_live_ tokens do not reach ProviderError text in clear form

domain: recognized Datamesh assignment and ed_live_ tokens are covered by the error-body redaction patterns
name: FC-forge-cli-dmm-error-secret-coverage

contract.declared_domain: ASCII serialized sasl.jaas.config record; value uses escaped-quote tokens, has len <= 2048 regex tokens, and contains no raw NUL/LF
contract.guarantee: an escaped-quote-safe sasl.jaas.config value is replaced as one quoted value before it reaches logs or persisted state
contract.input_source: serialized connector/provider configuration and engine error text

domain: serialized sasl.jaas.config values with escaped quotes are covered by the whole-value _JAAS_CONFIG_RE branch
name: FC-forge-cli-jaas-escaped-quote-coverage

contract.declared_domain: ASCII endpoint query fragment beginning with ? or &, recognized key, equals, and nonempty value with no ampersand
contract.guarantee: recognized endpoint query credentials are replaced before the AI test report exposes the endpoint
contract.input_source: configured LLM endpoint used by the AI setup/test report

domain: credential query parameters in an ASCII endpoint are covered by the redacted_endpoint substitution
name: FC-forge-cli-llm-query-secret-coverage

contract.declared_domain: ASCII key containing a case-insensitive sensitive token, key len 1..64
contract.guarantee: a sensitive KEY=VALUE argument is rendered with its value redacted before the dbt command reaches the CLI log

domain: every ASCII sensitive dbt -e key is recognized by SENSITIVE_ENV_KEY_RE
name: FC-forge-cli-sensitive-env-key-coverage

contract.declared_domain: ASCII credentialed URL with total len 1..64; scheme body len 1..41, user len 0..256, password len 1..4096, nonempty ASCII host
contract.guarantee: credentialed URL userinfo is recognized by the shared redaction sink while the scheme, user, and host remain available for diagnostics
contract.input_source: provider and operator endpoint text reaching shared logs and state

domain: every ASCII credentialed URL accepted by the product grammar is covered by _URL_USERINFO_RE (scheme/user/password/host; password len 1..4096)
name: FC-forge-cli-url-userinfo-coverage
